category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, couple a smaller learning rate with stronger dropout and weight decay to test whether gentler updates and regularization improve validation ranking under full-catalog cross-entropy. Preserve the existing Adam optimizer, architecture, loss, inference, seeds and training caps. Dropout is already passed explicitly during training; prediction disables dropout, so predictor and checkpoint shapes remain consistent.

change_summary: Jointly tune all four BERT4Rec category models: learning rate 5e-4, dropout 0.3 and weight decay 1e-5. Retain one checkpoint per category and all other behavior.
